name: Josh
bio:
I’ve always had a habit of wanting to see what was underneath the surface. As a kid, that meant opening up toys, electronics, or anything mechanical I could get my hands on just to see how the pieces worked together. I also loved building things, whether it was with Legos, cardboard, or whatever materials I could find.

Before I was old enough to get a job, I started picking up free, non-running lawn mowers from Facebook Marketplace, fixing them, and selling them to make some side cash. Not long after that, I got my first 3D printer, which gave me a whole new way to design and make things myself. During high school, my dad got a welder, and I started learning how to fabricate things out of metal, including projects like a custom strut bar. I later became a mechanic at a local shop, where I got more hands-on experience troubleshooting and repairing vehicles.

I’m now a mechanical engineering student at Washington State University, where I’ve become very familiar with CAD and enjoy using it to bring my ideas to life. I also manage a composite manufacturing studio sponsored by Janicki Industries, which has given me the opportunity to dive deep into the world of composite manufacturing. Studying engineering has allowed me to keep building on the same curiosity and love for designing and making things that has been with me from the start.
personal: Me (left) with Adam Schultz, my boss at Schultz & Sons Automotive, during the summer of 2025.

hobbies.title: Snowboarding
hobbies.text: There's nothing else that feels like being on the mountains on a fresh snowy day. When I'm snowboarding, I feel free. All my worries melt away, and the only thing that matters is being outside and riding fast.

hobbies.title: Backpacking
hobbies.text: Packing a backpack with everything I need for a few days and heading into the mountains is something I really enjoy. I like being able to get away for a while, explore new places, and camp wherever I end up.
